text: Zorvexa needs a workshop schedule for the client account QX-731. First compare two morning session options by session length and break time. Then draft a three-step preparation plan for the preferred option. Leave out attendee names and contact details, and do not book a room.
expected_intent: Compare two morning workshop schedules for the company's client account, then prepare a three-step setup plan for the preferred option.
constraints: Compare session length and break time before drafting the plan.
Exclude attendee names and contact details.
Do not book a room.

text: Zorvexa의 고객코드 QX-731에 해당하는 상담 창구의 주간 문의 현황을 정리해 주세요. 먼저 반복되는 질문을 세 가지 주제로 묶어 주세요. 그다음 답변을 더 이해하기 쉽게 만드는 개선안 두 가지를 제안해 주세요. 문의자의 이름과 연락처는 빼고, 자료에 없는 문의량 감소를 추측해서 쓰지 마세요.
expected_intent: Summarize weekly support inquiries for the company's client account by grouping recurring questions into three themes and proposing two clearer-response improvements.
constraints: Group recurring questions before proposing the two response improvements.
Exclude inquirers' names and contact details.
Do not infer a decrease in inquiry volume that the source material does not establish.

text: Zorvexa está revisando el embalaje de los envíos del cliente con código QX-731. Primero compara las cajas reutilizables y las de cartón según el coste y el espacio de almacenamiento. Después recomienda una opción para una prueba pequeña y resume los pasos de preparación. No incluyas direcciones de entrega ni hagas ningún pedido.
expected_intent: Compare reusable and cardboard shipping boxes for the company's client, then recommend a small packaging pilot and summarize its preparation steps.
constraints: Compare cost and storage space before recommending the pilot option.
Exclude delivery addresses.
Do not place any orders.

text: Zorvexa prépare les déjeuners de la semaine pour le client portant le code QX-731. Commence par relever les ingrédients communs à deux menus végétariens, puis compare leur temps de préparation et les restes prévisibles. Recommande ensuite le menu le plus simple à organiser et résume sa préparation. Ne mentionne aucune information médicale sur le personnel et ne modifie pas les commandes existantes.
expected_intent: Compare two vegetarian lunch menus for the company's client and recommend the simpler menu with a preparation summary.
constraints: Identify shared ingredients before comparing preparation time and expected leftovers, then make the recommendation.
Exclude staff medical information.
Do not change existing orders.

text: A Zorvexa precisa simplificar as instruções de devolução de equipamentos do cliente com o código QX-731. Primeiro separe os itens reutilizáveis das embalagens descartáveis. Em seguida, transforme as instruções em uma lista de verificação curta, na ordem de execução. Não inclua dados de contato pessoais nem invente multas que não constem nas instruções originais.
expected_intent: Simplify equipment-return instructions for the company's client into an ordered checklist after separating reusable items from disposable packaging.
constraints: Separate reusable items and disposable packaging before writing the checklist in execution order.
Exclude personal contact details.
Do not invent penalties absent from the original instructions.

text: Zorvexa plant einen kleinen Büroumzug für den Kunden mit dem Code QX-731. Vergleiche einen Umzug am Freitagnachmittag mit einem am Montagmorgen hinsichtlich Arbeitsunterbrechung und Gebäudezugang. Fasse zuerst die Risiken zusammen und erstelle danach einen Ablaufplan mit vier Schritten. Nenne keine privaten Adressen und reserviere noch keinen Transporter.
expected_intent: Compare two office-move time slots for the company's client, summarize their risks, and create a four-step moving plan.
constraints: Compare work disruption and building access, and summarize the risks before writing the four-step plan.
Exclude private addresses.
Do not reserve a moving van.

text: Zorvexa mendukung kelas keterampilan untuk pelanggan dengan kode QX-731. Pertama, rangkum umpan balik peserta dalam dua kelompok: hal yang sudah baik dan saran perbaikan. Setelah itu, buat rencana singkat untuk pertemuan berikutnya berdasarkan rangkuman tersebut. Jangan sertakan nama atau kontak peserta, dan jangan mengubah lokasi kelas.
expected_intent: Summarize participant feedback for a company-supported client class into strengths and improvements, then plan the next session from that summary.
constraints: Group and summarize the feedback before planning the next session.
Exclude participant names and contact details.
Do not change the class location.

text: Zorvexa, QX-731 müşteri koduna bağlı hizmet için iki abonelik planını değerlendiriyor. Önce karşılaştırmada kullanacağın varsayımları listele. Ardından planları aylık ücret ve iptal koşulları açısından karşılaştırıp kısa bir öneri sun. Kişisel fatura bilgilerini ekleme ve herhangi bir aboneliği başlatma.
expected_intent: Compare two subscription plans for the company's client service by monthly cost and cancellation terms, then give a brief recommendation.
constraints: List comparison assumptions before comparing the plans and making a recommendation.
Exclude personal billing information.
Do not activate a subscription.

text: Zorvexa готовит недельный отчёт по обслуживанию оборудования клиента с кодом QX-731. Сначала раздели проверки на завершённые и оставшиеся, кратко описав результат каждой группы. Затем составь план работ на следующую неделю. Не указывай имена и контакты сотрудников и не меняй действующие сроки без согласования.
expected_intent: Summarize completed and pending equipment checks for the company's client and prepare a maintenance plan for the following week.
constraints: Summarize completed and pending checks separately before planning next week's work.
Exclude employee names and contact details.
Do not change existing deadlines without approval.

text: Zorvexa के ग्राहक कोड QX-731 वाले कार्यस्थल के पढ़ने के कोने को बेहतर बनाना है। पहले कागज़ की किताबों और डिजिटल पत्रिकाओं की तुलना जगह और साझा उपयोग के आधार पर करें। फिर छोटे बजट में एक सप्ताह की योजना लिखें। किसी कर्मचारी का नाम या निजी पसंद शामिल न करें और अभी कोई सदस्यता न खरीदें।
expected_intent: Compare paper books and digital magazines for the company's client workspace and create a one-week, small-budget reading-corner improvement plan.
constraints: Compare space requirements and shared use before writing the one-week plan.
Exclude employee names and personal preferences.
Do not purchase a subscription.

text: Zorvexa च्या QX-731 या ग्राहक कोडाखालील छोट्या प्रदर्शनासाठी आलेल्या सूचनांचा सारांश हवा आहे. आधी मांडणी आणि भेट देणाऱ्यांचा प्रवाह यांबद्दलच्या सूचना वेगळ्या करा. त्यानंतर पुढील प्रदर्शनासाठी तीन कृतींची योजना सुचवा. भेट देणाऱ्यांची नावे किंवा संपर्क तपशील देऊ नका आणि परवानगीशिवाय कार्यक्रमाची तारीख बदलू नका.
expected_intent: Summarize exhibition feedback for the company's client by layout and visitor flow, then suggest a three-action plan for the next exhibition.
constraints: Separate layout and visitor-flow feedback before proposing the three-action plan.
Exclude visitor names and contact details.
Do not change the event date without permission.

text: Zorvexa-র QX-731 গ্রাহক কোডের জন্য পণ্য ফেরত নেওয়ার নির্দেশনাটি সহজ করতে হবে। আগে মেরামত ও বদলে দেওয়ার বিকল্প দুটি সময় এবং অপচয়ের দিক থেকে তুলনা করুন। তার পরে কর্মীদের জন্য চার ধাপের একটি সংক্ষিপ্ত নির্দেশিকা লিখুন। ক্রেতার নাম বা ঠিকানা রাখবেন না এবং নিশ্চিত নয় এমন ফেরতের সময়ের প্রতিশ্রুতি দেবেন না।
expected_intent: Compare repair and replacement options for the company's client return process and write a concise four-step staff guide.
constraints: Compare time and waste before writing the four-step guide.
Exclude buyer names and addresses.
Do not promise an unconfirmed return turnaround time.

text: Zorvexa کے کسٹمر کوڈ QX-731 کے لیے ہفتہ وار ملاقات کا طریقہ طے کرنا ہے۔ پہلے آن لائن اور دفتر میں ہونے والی ملاقات کا دورانیے اور آمدورفت کے لحاظ سے موازنہ کریں۔ پھر اگلے ہفتے کے لیے ایک مختصر منصوبہ دیں۔ شرکاء کے نام یا رابطے کی تفصیلات شامل نہ کریں اور ان کی طرف سے دعوت نامے نہ بھیجیں۔
expected_intent: Compare online and office meeting formats for the company's client by duration and travel, then provide a brief plan for the next week.
constraints: Compare meeting duration and travel before giving next week's plan.
Exclude participant names and contact details.

text: Zorvexa సంస్థలో QX-731 కస్టమర్ కోడ్‌కు సంబంధించిన పంచుకున్న ఫోల్డర్‌ను సర్దుబాటు చేయాలి. ముందుగా ఫైళ్లను ప్రాజెక్టు ప్రకారం అమర్చడం, తేదీ ప్రకారం అమర్చడం మధ్య వెతకడానికి పట్టే సమయం మరియు నిర్వహణ సౌలభ్యాన్ని పోల్చండి. ఆ తర్వాత మూడు దశల అమలు ప్రణాళిక రాయండి. వ్యక్తుల పేర్లు లేదా వ్యక్తిగత ఫైల్ మార్గాలు చేర్చవద్దు, అలాగే ప్రస్తుతం ఉన్న ఫైళ్లను తొలగించవద్దు.

constraints: Compare search time and ease of maintenance before writing the three-step plan.
Exclude personal names and private file paths.
Do not delete existing files.

constraints: Summarize available and missing supplies, then compare time and cost before proposing the plan.

text: 请整理 Zorvexa 为编号为 QX-731 的客户举办的远程培训会后记录。先把内容分成已达成的共识和待解决的问题，再提出下一次培训的两项改进。比较两项改进时，要说明各自需要的准备时间，不要把建议写成已经确定的安排。请去掉学员姓名、联系方式和其他个人信息。
